title: Duck Soap Dish
author: FatherLicorice
description:
**Print profiles updated 4/13/24**

What can I say? Its a soap dish shaped like a duck! Or, a duck shaped like a soap dish?

**There are two versions of this soap dish:**

-One with feet, appearing to be standing

-One without feet, appearing to be resting on its belly

**Thanks to their built-in drain, these Duck Soap Dishes will spit out any excess suds or water directly into your sink or bathtub!**

I printed the example models in generic PLA, using .40mm nozzle, .16mm Optimal layer profile, 3 walls, and 25% lightning infill on a Bambulab X1 Carbon.

**Enjoy!**
